summary: Private connector approvals and reliable chat recovery in your existing pod.

improvements: Review and approve a private connector call before your pod resumes it.
Pasted text attachments and restored activity follow the current One chat flow.
fixes: Interrupted chat streams report a retryable failure instead of waiting silently.
Hosting and Software updates retain their titles while Settings closes.
Settings and Feed keep an approved update visible until its outcome is verified.
security: Connector approval remains bound to the exact owner, pod, tool and arguments.
A replaced pod identity cannot consume an earlier approval.
